Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable mute/micmute LEDs and limit mic boost on EliteBook

On HP EliteBook 835/845/845W G10, the audio LEDs can be enabled by
ALC285_FIXUP_HP_MUTE_LED. So use it accordingly.
